metadata.description: A collection of Product Management productivity plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: meeting-summarize
plugins.description: Clean and summarize meeting transcripts from SRT, VTT, TSV, TXT and MD formats. Detects meeting type and applies the appropriate summary template.

plugins.name: claude-md
plugins.description: Create and refactor CLAUDE.md project instruction files following best practices for minimal, high-signal Claude Code guidance.
